The rear fog lights do not work when the button on the relevant switch unit is operated with the key ON and the dipped beams on.

STEP

OPERATIONS TO BE CARRIED OUT

TEST RESULTS

1

INDIVIDUAL LIGHT CHECK

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Check the condition of the bulbs and associated bulb holder;

Move on to Step

1. Bulbs damaged

1. Change the bulbs

Op. 5540A74 BULB OF A SIDELIGHT OR FOG LAMP OR REVERSING LIGHT IN A TAIL-LIGHT, LH OR RH R R

2. Tail-light cluster fault

2. Replace or change the tail-light cluster

Op. 5540A44 L/H OR R/H TAIL LIGHT (ONE) - R+R

2

REAR FOG LIGHT ELECTRICAL CIRCUIT CHECK

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Check the following, in order:

  • Connections between battery, ignition switch, facia control unit, switch control unit;
  • Connections between stalk unit and switch control unit;
  • Connections between switch control unit and bulbs;
  • Stalk unit earth;
  • Bulb earth

Move on to Step

1. Component defective

1. Replace defective component (in the case of a fuse, find out what caused it to blow).

2. Connections interrupted

2. Repair the connections

See E2031 REAR FOG LAMPS

3

STEERING COLUMN SWITCH UNIT CHECK

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Check that an earth signal output is generated to the switch control unit when the stalk switch wheel is turned to dipped/main beam

See E2031 REAR FOG LAMPS

Move on to Step

Stalk unit not working properly

Replace the steering column switch unit

Op. 5550A12 COMPLETE STALK UNIT - R+R FOR VERSIONS WITH AIR BAG

4

SWITCH CONTROL UNIT CHECK

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Check the following, in order:

  • Correct power supply to switch control unit
  • Check that an battery voltage output is generated to control the rear fog light bulbs when the rear fog light button is activated

Move on to Step

1. Power supply incorrect

1. Switch control unit fault

2. Restore correct power supply

See E2031 REAR FOG LAMPS

2. Change switch control unit

CHECK ON CORRECT OPERATION

ALL OK
